name: spritegen
description: Generate, inspect, slice, preview, and package consistent 2D pixel-art asset sheets.

interface.shortDescription: Create 2D pixel-art sprites, icons, props, tiles, and animation strips.
interface.longDescription: Spritegen provides a reusable AI-agent workflow for generating 2D pixel-art assets with image models, then deterministically slicing, validating, previewing, and packaging the results.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Spritegen to create a consistent 2D pixel-art asset sheet, validate it, and package the usable files.
